patterns.note: The site uses a clean, minimalist grid layout for image galleries and content sections, allowing photography to be the primary visual focus.
A strong contrast is created between small, uppercase sans-serif text for navigation and labels, and very large, bold serif typography for the brand name in the footer.
The color palette is dominated by stark black and white for text and backgrounds, complemented by the rich, natural tones present in the editorial photography.
The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
The hero image scrolls at a slightly slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax effect as the page content moves over it.
Image galleries are presented in a flexible grid that adapts to different aspect ratios, maintaining visual interest without rigid uniformity.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element that remains visible at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll.

The initial hero section uses a large, full-bleed background image that scrolls at a slower rate than the page content, creating a subtle parallax effect as foreground text and subsequent sections scroll over it.

Content sections below the hero are revealed by standard vertical scrolling, with no apparent scroll-triggered animations like fade-ins or slide-ups; the design relies on static hierarchy and strong imagery.

design_tokens.type_scale: A dramatic contrast between small, uppercase sans-serif labels (~0.5x body) and an extremely oversized, bold serif brand logo (~10x body), with body text being a comfortable reading size.
design_tokens.radius: sharp — all elements feature crisp, unrounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous whitespace surrounds images and text blocks, creating a sense of calm and allowing content to breathe, especially in the hero and footer sections.

standout: This site stands out with its bold, editorial aesthetic, prioritizing large-scale, high-quality photography and minimalist layouts. The dramatic use of oversized serif typography for the brand name in the footer creates a powerful and memorable visual statement, elevating it beyond a typical content site.
